blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Although I did not like math, I had to study logarithms.
exercises.ru: ___ мне не нравилась математика, я должен был выучить логарифмы.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I went out in spite of the rain.
exercises.ru: Я вышла, ___ дождь.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He went out in spite of the storm.
exercises.ru: Он вышел ___ шторм.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Though it was cold, he didn't light the fire.
exercises.ru: ___ было холодно, он не разжигал огонь.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: At least somebody is having a good time.
exercises.ru: ___ хоть кому-то весело.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: But there are other advantages.
exercises.ru: ___ есть другие преимущества.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Though very busy, she came to see me off.
exercises.ru: ___ занятость, она пришла меня проводить.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You came despite my ban.
exercises.ru: Вы пришли, ___ мой запрет.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He is active although he is very old.
exercises.ru: Он активен, ___ солидный возраст.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Yoshio continued to believe it despite the rebuttal.
exercises.ru: ___ наличие опровержения, Ёшио продолжал в это верить.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: How come these apples are wormy although they've been sprayed?
exercises.ru: Как так вышло, что в яблоках есть черви, ___ их опрыскивали инсектицидами?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: How come these apples are wormy although they've been sprayed?
exercises.ru: Как так вышло, что в яблоках есть черви, ___ их обработали инсектицидом?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Although Tom attended Harvard business school, he never went to its library.
exercises.ru: ___ Том учился в Гарвардской школе предпринимательства, однако он ни разу не был в тамошней библиотеке.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: They still attacked us, despite clearly agreeing to sign the non-aggression pact.
exercises.ru: Они продолжали нападать на нас, ___ однозначное согласие подписать пакт о ненападении.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Having retired from the sport decades ago, Tom has nevertheless subtly managed to keep himself in the limelight.
exercises.ru: ___ Том давным-давно закончил со спортом, он всё же ненавязчиво держится на виду.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Personally I'm always ready to learn, although I do not always like being taught.
exercises.ru: Лично я всегда готов учиться, ___ я не люблю, когда меня поучают.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Despite the fact that Tom was the leader, he never shied away from the hardest and dirtiest work.
exercises.ru: ___ Том был руководителем, он никогда не чурался самой тяжёлой и грязной работы.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Even though John could fight, Adrion was still the strongest out of the three of us.
exercises.ru: ___ Джон и умел драться, сильнейшим из нас троих всё равно оставался Адрион.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Though autumn gales are less clement than summer zephyrs, they are more exciting.
exercises.ru: ___ осенние ветра не такие мягкие, как летние западные, они более бодрящие.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Despite being released with strong DRM, the game got cracked within a week.
exercises.ru: ___ надежные предустановленные технические средства защиты авторских прав, игру взломали за неделю.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
